summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, announcing a routine cash dividend of NT$5.2 per share with an ex-dividend date of July 9, 2026, and a payment date of August 7, 2026. This is a standard dividend distribution, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate event is involved. The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer regarding a dividend record date.
